description: This file defines the schema, methods, and events for the RemoteControl API, which provides functionalities related to remote control pairing, IR programming, firmware updates, and remote management for a plugin or module in a software project.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Gets the current API version number.

methods.name: getNetStatus
methods.description: Returns the status information provided by the last `onStatus` event for the specified network.

methods.name: startPairing
methods.description: Initiates pairing a remote with the STB on the specified network.

methods.name: stopPairing
methods.description: Cancels pairing a remote with the STB on the specified network.

methods.name: clearIRCodes
methods.description: Clears the IR codes from the specified remote.

methods.name: setIRCode
methods.description: Programs an IR code into the specified remote control.

methods.name: getIRCodesByAutoLookup
methods.description: Returns a list of available IR codes for the TV and AVRs specified by the input parameters.

methods.name: getIRCodesByNames
methods.description: Returns a list of IR codes for the AV device specified by the input parameters.

methods.name: getIRDBManufacturers
methods.description: Returns a list of manufacturer names based on the specified input parameters.

methods.name: getIRDBModels
methods.description: Returns a list of model names based on the specified input parameters.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Returns last key press source data.

methods.name: configureWakeupKeys
methods.description: Configures which keys on the remote will wake the target from deepsleep.

methods.name: findMyRemote
methods.description: Tells the most recently used remote to beep.

methods.name: factoryReset
methods.description: Tells all paired and connected remotes to factory reset.

methods.name: unpair
methods.description: Unpairs a given or all remote(s) from the STB.

methods.name: startFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Starts a firmware image update session for the specified remote(s).

methods.name: statusFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Returns the status of an active firmware image update session.

methods.name: cancelFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Cancels an active firmware image update session.
